solutionSql: SELECT s.id, LEFT(s.tracking_code, 2) AS prefix, (s.booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS booked_day FROM shipments AS s WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 10 ORDER BY s.id;

rules.howSolved: LEFT(tracking_code, 2) returns the first two characters.
booked_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' gives the UTC wall-clock time, and ::date keeps the calendar day.

notes: Read-only item. The sample days match the ticket's stated values: shipments 1 and 2 on 2026-01-31, shipments 3 to 10 on 2025-12-28. Ran without error on sample, nulls and boundary. Solve time is an estimate.
